name: Telegram
summary: Telegram's official Bot API lets anyone create a bot through @BotFather and talk to it over HTTPS with long polling or webhooks. Recent API versions add features aimed at AI bots, such as streamed message drafts, rich messages and guest mode. Frameworks like grammY wrap the API for TypeScript and JavaScript.
facts: Official Bot API (HTTPS, polling or webhooks)
Free; paid broadcasts above 30 msg/s cost 0.1 Stars per message
About 1 msg/s per chat, 20 msg/min per group
goodFor: Personal agents reachable from any phone
Prototyping a chat agent in minutes
watchOut: Bot chats are not end-to-end encrypted
Users must find and start the bot first
